content.value: The vanilla mace, trident, turtle helmet, and Elytra are always classified as Unique. This classification comes from the item itself and overrides any stored rarity value.

Their special statistics are a preset part of the item rather than a player-selected random affix pool.
The Runic Altar rejects all operations on them, including random, targeted, Artificial, Divine, Chaos, and Annulment tomes.
They cannot be converted to Magic or Rare and do not use the normal prefix/suffix crafting limits.
Their actual bonuses are shown directly on the item tooltip and are applied when the item is equipped in its proper slot.

Unique does not block the separate quality and enchantment-slot systems. A compatible Unique can still be improved at the Quality Station, receive Deepslate Sigil slots up to its item-type cap, and use approved enchantments within those slots.
Unique items do not appear in the rune-pool reference because those pages describe affixes that a player can actually roll through ordinary rune crafting.
